_comment: Advisories the npm-audit CI gate is allowed to ignore, each with a reason and
An entry is NOT a dismissal -- the gate FAILS once review_by passes, so an
exception cannot rot silently. If it is still unfixable on that date, extend it
deliberately with fresh reasoning rather than by habit.
Only add an entry when the vulnerable code path is genuinely unreachable in
this application, and say how that was established.
Matching is by advisory id ONLY: one entry silences that id in every audited
directory. `directory` is used only for the "entry no longer matches" warning,
so it names where the entry is expected to apply, not where it is enforced.

allow.reason: braces 3.0.3 (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm) has no patched version upstream. Since ops #4366 (#349) dev-only: reached via jest micromatch (root chokidar, the former production path, was removed as unused) (the same transitive path appears in api/; the gate matches by id only; the dashboard/ tree was retired in ops #4365). Exposure: brace patterns come from repo config/globs at build/test time, never user input, so the nested-pattern stack-exhaustion DoS is not reachable. Re-review by 2026-11-05 (ops #4362).

sprintf-js 1.0.3 (GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c, moderate, published 2026-09-24) has no patched version upstream (affects <= 1.1.3, the latest). DEV-ONLY in both . and api/: jest coverage -> babel-plugin-istanbul -> @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config -> js-yaml@3 -> argparse@1 -> sprintf-js, established from package-lock.json (dev: true in both). The DoS needs an attacker-controlled format string; argparse only formats its own help/usage templates at test time, and nothing ships to prod (npm ci --omit=dev). Re-review by 2026-11-05 (ops #4368).
